title: Spiritual Gifts
definition: Spiritual gifts are gracious enablements given by God to believers for ministry, service, and the building up of the body of Christ.
summary: Spiritual gifts are not badges of superiority. They are entrusted for humble service under Christ’s lordship and must be exercised in love and biblical order.
christFocus: Every gift should exalt Christ, strengthen His church, and serve others. Love, truth, and edification are the proper atmosphere for all spiritual gifts.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Gifts differ, but the body is one.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The purpose of gifts is service, maturity, and the glory of God.
